paragraphs.text: OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint that forwards model calls through a running DeepSeek Harness
# dsh-endpoint

Expose the model providers and models already configured in DeepSeek Harness as an
OpenAI-compatible

l providers and models already configured in DeepSeek Harness as an
OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint.

The endpoint only forwards. It holds no provider credentials and never talks to a
provider directly:

every model call goes through `ctx.llm.stream()`, so DSH's provider
adapters (credentials, protocol

differences, retries, image handling, token usage) keep
owning the real request.

## Architecture
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- **Plugin only.** No second process, no second credential store.
- **Sessions are real.** Each conv

ersation is mirrored into a DSH session, so it shows
up in the sidebar and can be inspected.
- **Rea

d-only mirrors.** The mirrored session holds the persistence write handle, so the
GUI refuses to res
ume it (`already owned by an active write handle`).
## Install
Requires DeepSeek Harness Desktop (web profile) 0.2.1-rc.x.

> **No authentication, no rate limiting.** The endpoint spends your configured
> model quota for any

one who can reach it. Keep it on `127.0.0.1` unless you put
> it behind a proxy you control, and dis
able the plugin to switch it off.

Restart the app after installing: host plugins are ESM modules, and reinstalling does
not replace th
e module already loaded in the running process.
## Settings page
**Settings → Model Endpoint** (a custom section, same level as plugin pages).
| Field | Meaning |

| Listen address | `127.0.0.1` (local only) or `0.0.0.0` (all interfaces) |
| Port | default `43130`

; the GUI owns `43129` |
| Default model | used when a request omits `model` |
| Model aliases | JSO

N map, e.g. `{"gpt-4o": "opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash"}` |
| Session mirror | write each API conv

ersation into a DSH session |
| Mapping retention | days an external conversation id keeps its sessi

on after last use |
| Workspace directory | workspace that groups mirrored sessions |

Saving applies immediately: **changing the listen address or port rebinds the listener
in place** (t

he old listener closes, the new one binds, and a failed bind rolls back to
the previous address). Sw

itching `127.0.0.1 ↔ 0.0.0.0` takes the same path. Toggling the
mirror or changing the workspace dir

ectory still needs a plugin reload, because those are
built at startup.
In-flight streaming responses are dropped when the listener moves.

The page reads and writes two loopback-only routes: `GET /dsh-endpoint/state` and
`GET|PUT /dsh-endp

oint/config`. Saves go to the user layer
`$DSH_HOME/dsh-endpoint/config.json`, which is merged over
the plugin config at startup.
## HTTP API
| Method | Path | Notes |

| `GET` | `/healthz` | liveness + registered providers |
| `GET` | `/v1/models` | `provider/model` i

ds plus aliases |
| `GET` | `/v1/models/{id}` | one model |
| `POST` | `/v1/chat/completions` | stre
aming and non-streaming |
Model ids are `provider/model`, e.g. `opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash`.

**Supported:** `messages` (system/user/assistant/tool), `tools` and `tool_calls`
pass-through, `temp

erature`, `max_tokens` / `max_completion_tokens`, `stream`,
`stream_options.include_usage`, `stop` (

truncated endpoint-side because not every
adapter accepts it).

**Rejected explicitly:** `n > 1`, `tool_choice` other than `"auto"`, remote (`http(s)`) media
URLs,
`file_id` references, and binary documents (PDF/DOCX).
## Attachments
Inline base64 only — the endpoint never fetches remote URLs on a client's behalf.
| Input | Handling |
| `image_url` with `data:image/{png,jpeg,webp,gif};base64,…` | decoded → `ctx.attachments.saveImages

` → `ImageBlock`; the adapter resizes per route |
| `image_url` with `http(s)://…` | 400: send a dat

a URL instead |
| `file` part with `file_data` of `text/*`, JSON, YAML, XML, JS, SQL | inlined as a

`text` block (512 KiB cap, filename preserved) |
| `file` part with a binary document (PDF, DOCX, …)

| 400: text extraction is not implemented |
| `file` part with `file_id` | 400: the Files API is no

traction is not implemented |
| `file` part with `file_id` | 400: the Files API is not implemented |

Attachments live in DSH's attachment store, so the mirrored session keeps a compact reference
instea
d of megabytes of base64.
### Limits
| Limit | Value | Source |
| Request body | 20 MiB, max 300 MiB | `limits.maxBodyBytes`, a plugin default. DSH's own `/api` lim

it is 300 MiB (314572800); higher values are rejected |
| One inline text file | 8 MiB, never above

the body cap | `limits.maxTextFileBytes`, a plugin default. DSH sets no file-size limit |
| One imag

e | 20 MiB | DSH attachment service (not this plugin) |
| Images per message | 20 | DSH attachment s

ervice |
| Total image bytes per message | 200 MiB | DSH attachment service |
| Image pixels / longe
st side | 64 MP / 8192 px | DSH attachment service |

The text-file cap is a prompt-size guard, not a protocol limit: the body is already
bounded by `maxB

odyBytes`, and a file near the cap is far past most models' context
windows. Truncation is announced
in the inlined text, so the model knows it is partial.

**Ignored on purpose:** every other unknown field (`top_p`, `seed`, `service_tier`,
`metadata`, …).

Real clients send fields this build does not model; rejecting them would
break more than it protects
, so they are logged and dropped rather than silently applied.
## Limitations

- No authentication and no rate limiting. The stop switch is disabling the plugin. Keep
it on `127.0

.0.1`; binding `0.0.0.0` lets anyone who can reach the port spend your quota.
- Inline images and te

xt files only; remote media URLs and binary documents are refused.
- `n > 1`, `tool_choice` other th

an `auto`, `logprobs`, `top_p`, `seed` are not applied.
- Mirrored sessions cannot be continued in t

he GUI by design.
- Pinned to DSH internal packages (`0.2.1-rc.x`); API changes there can break this

y design.
